ov: الإشبينات (الإنجليزية: Bridesmaids) هو فيلم كوميدي تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وصدر في سنة 2011. الفيلم من كتابة كريستين ويج.
plotEn:
Annie Walker is a single, underachieving woman living in Milwaukee. Following the Great Recession, her bakery, Cake Baby, went out of business. She now works a stressful, underpaid job at a jewelry store and shares an apartment with obnoxious roommates. She regularly has casual sex with the wealthy, self-absorbed Ted, though she desires a more committed relationship with him. The only positive presence in Annie's life is her lifelong best friend, Lillian.
Lillian becomes engaged to her boyfriend Doug and asks Annie to be her maid of honor. At the engagement party, Annie meets Lillian's other bridesmaids — Lillian's long-married cousin Rita; Lillian's naive, newlywed coworker Becca; Doug's foul-mouthed but friendly sister Megan; and Helen Harris, the wealthy and beautiful but snobbish wife of Doug's boss. Annie and Helen are instantly jealous of each other's friendships with Lillian and become increasingly competitive for her attention.
On the way home from the engagement party, Annie is pulled over by police officer Nathan Rhodes due to her erratic driving. She completes a sobriety test, which she passes; however, she is ticketed for having broken brake lights. The pair get talking and Rhodes realizes that Annie was the owner of Cake Baby, of which he was a regular customer. Officer Rhodes agrees to rescind Annie's ticket on the condition that she gets her lights fixed.
